label: Licence / document
title: title
description: Every licence, certificate, tender, work order and drawing, with expiry reminders.

label: Ledger
title: name
description: Chart of accounts. Codes (SALES_RMC, GST_OUTPUT...) are what posting rules refer to.

fields.name: code
fields.label: Code
fields.help: Used by posting rules, e.g. SALES_RMC

label: Journal
title: narration
description: Double-entry voucher. Posted automatically from module documents, or entered by hand.

label: Sales invoice
description: GST invoice. Module invoices (RMC, bitumen, bricks, bunk credit) are created here by their billing runs.

label: Purchase invoice
description: Vendor bill, matched against PO and GRN (3-way match) before approval.

label: Receipt
description: Money received from a customer: cash, UPI, cheque or bank transfer.

label: Payment
description: Money paid to a vendor, sub-contractor or employee. Approval rules decide who signs off.

label: Expense
description: Site / plant petty expense with a bill photo. Approved expenses post to the ledger.

label: Bank statement line
title: narration
description: Imported bank statement lines, matched to receipts and payments.

label: Lead
title: contact_name
description: Every enquiry, from any source, in one list. Assigned by area and business line.

fields.name: requirement
fields.label: Requirement
fields.help: e.g. 30 m³ M25 for slab on Friday

label: Quotation
description: Rates from the price list; discounts beyond the limit go for approval.

label: Construction site spotted
title: site_name
description: Salespeople pin construction sites they pass; repeat visits are tracked and nearby sites suggested.

label: Mix design
title: grade
description: Approved quantities per m³. Material cost per m³ is worked out from the latest purchase rates.

fields.name: wc_ratio
fields.label: W/C ratio
fields.check: wc_ratio is null or wc_ratio between 0.25 and 0.7

label: RMC order
title: grade
description: Customer order with pour slot. Credit limit is checked before confirming.

label: Batch
title: doc_no
description: One load. Actual weights are compared with the mix design; material is taken out of stock.

fields.name: deviation_pct
fields.label: Deviation %
fields.expr: case when coalesce(target_qty, 0) = 0 then 0 else round((actual_qty - target_qty) / target_qty * 100, 2) end

label: Delivery challan
title: doc_no
description: Printed on Bluetooth printer even offline (number from the phone's reserved block). Signed on the phone at site.

fields.name: site_wait_min
fields.label: Waiting at site (min)
fields.expr: case when reached_site_at is null or pour_start_at is null then null else (extract(epoch from pour_start_at - reached_site_at) / 60)::int end

label: Cube test
title: doc_no
description: Samples cast per pour; results at 7 and 28 days (configurable). Failures alert the plant head.

label: Production batch
title: doc_no
description: Each batch with temperature. Materials used come off stock; temperature outside the JMF band is flagged.

label: Weighment ticket
title: vehicle_no
description: First and second weight from the scale with camera snapshots. Net goes to the GRN or dispatch automatically.

fields.name: short_kg
fields.label: Short vs party (−)
fields.expr: case when party_qty_kg is null or second_weight_kg is null then null else abs(second_weight_kg - first_weight_kg) - coalesce(deduction_kg, 0) - party_qty_kg end

label: Daily production
title: doc_no
description: One screen for the supervisor. Materials are taken from the recipe; good units go to the curing yard.

label: Project
title: name
description: One project per site location. Contract terms drive RA bill deductions.

label: BOQ item
title: description
description: Bill of quantities. Material norms link to RMC, bricks and bitumen orders.

label: Daily progress report
title: doc_no
description: Site engineer's day: work done with photos, manpower, machines, materials, hindrances.

label: RA bill
title: doc_no
description: Running account bill: cumulative quantities, deductions as per contract, certified amount tracking.

fields.name: net_payable
fields.label: Net payable
fields.expr: coalesce(this_bill_value, 0) + coalesce(gst_amount, 0) - coalesce(retention, 0) - coalesce(security_deposit, 0) - coalesce(mobilisation_recovery, 0) - coalesce(income_tax_tds, 0) - coalesce(gst_tds, 0) - coalesce(labour_cess, 0) - coalesce(material_recovery, 0) - coalesce(other_deductions, 0)

fields.name: certification_gap
fields.label: Not certified
fields.expr: case when certified_value is null then null else coalesce(this_bill_value, 0) - certified_value end

fields.name: rate
fields.label: Rate
fields.help: Taken from the BOQ if left blank

label: Labour attendance
title: worker_name
description: Supervisor marks workers with a face photo inside the site geofence (works offline).

fields.name: calibration_chart
fields.label: Calibration chart
fields.help: [[dip_mm, litres], ...] from the tank's calibration certificate

fields.name: current_totaliser
fields.label: Current totaliser
fields.help: Enter once when the nozzle is set up; shift closings keep it current

label: Selling price
title: product
description: Daily retail selling price per product; changes take effect at the given time.

label: Shift
description: Open with opening readings, close with closing readings and cash. Sale = closing − opening − testing.

fields.name: expected_collection
fields.label: Expected cash
fields.expr: coalesce(sale_value, 0) - coalesce(credit_sales, 0) - coalesce(internal_issues, 0) - coalesce(upi_pos, 0) - coalesce(fleet_card, 0) - coalesce(expenses_paid, 0)

fields.name: short_excess
fields.label: Short (−) / excess (+)
fields.expr: coalesce(cash_counted, 0) - (coalesce(sale_value, 0) - coalesce(credit_sales, 0) - coalesce(internal_issues, 0) - coalesce(upi_pos, 0) - coalesce(fleet_card, 0) - coalesce(expenses_paid, 0))

fields.name: sale_litres
fields.label: Sale
fields.expr: case when closing is null then 0 else closing - opening - coalesce(testing, 0) end

fields.name: sale_value
fields.label: Value
fields.expr: round(case when closing is null then 0 else closing - opening - coalesce(testing, 0) end * coalesce(rate, 0), 2)

label: Tank dip
title: tank_id
description: Morning dip. Litres come from the tank's calibration chart; book vs dip variance is checked.

label: Tanker receipt
description: Decantation check: invoice qty and density vs actual dips before and after.

fields.name: product
fields.label: Product
fields.help: Taken from the tank if left blank

label: Fuel to group vehicle
description: One entry: bunk stock goes down, the vehicle's fuel log goes up, and an inter-company bill is raised.

fields.name: odometer_km
fields.label: Km (odometer)
fields.expr: case when end_odometer is null then null else end_odometer - start_odometer end

label: Fuel fill
title: vehicle_id
description: Every fill. Mileage vs norm is worked out against the previous fill.

fields.name: downtime_hours
fields.label: Downtime
fields.expr: case when down_to is null or down_from is null then null else round(extract(epoch from down_to - down_from) / 3600, 1) end

label: Machine log
title: vehicle_id
description: Daily log for JCBs, rollers, pavers: hours worked, idle, fuel, operator.

fields.name: hours_worked
fields.label: Hours
fields.expr: case when end_hours is null then null else end_hours - start_hours end

label: Indent
description: Request from a site, plant or bunk. Central buying groups approved indents into POs.

label: Purchase order
title: doc_no
description: Every line shows the last rates paid across all group companies.

label: Goods receipt
title: doc_no
description: What actually arrived. Weighbridge net fills the qty for bulk materials. Stock goes up here.

fields.name: short_qty
fields.label: Short
fields.expr: case when challan_qty is null then 0 else challan_qty - received_qty end

label: Stock transfer
description: Move stock between locations. Between group companies it becomes a sale and a purchase automatically.

label: Material issue
description: Store issues material to a BOQ item, vehicle or machine.

label: Stock count
description: Blind count: the counter does not see system stock. Differences post on approval.

fields.name: worked_hours
fields.label: Hours
fields.expr: case when in_time is null or out_time is null then null else round(extract(epoch from out_time - in_time) / 3600, 2) end

fields.name: days
fields.label: Days
fields.expr: case when half_day then 0.5 else (to_date - from_date + 1) end

label: Salary advance
description: Requested on the phone, approved, paid by UPI, recovered from salary automatically.

label: Payroll run
title: month
description: Monthly salary for a location: attendance, OT, incentives from operations, PF/ESI/PT/TDS, advance recovery.

fields.name: net_pay
fields.label: Net pay
fields.expr: coalesce(earned_basic_da, 0) + coalesce(earned_other, 0) + coalesce(ot_amount, 0) + coalesce(incentive, 0) - coalesce(pf_employee, 0) - coalesce(esi_employee, 0) - coalesce(pt, 0) - coalesce(tds, 0) - coalesce(advance_recovery, 0)
